title: Kissed and Dense Peruvian Sirloin Steak Rocoto Relleno
description: A hearty Peruvian-inspired dish featuring sirloin steak tips, pickled red onion, and a dash of queso fresco, all wrapped up in a flavorful rocoto relleno. Perfect for a cold and rainy day.

ingredients.name: rocoto peppers
ingredients.notes: substitute with bell peppers if rocotos are not available

instructions: Cut the tip of each rocoto pepper to create a small opening and remove the seeds and membranes.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sirloin steak tips and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked to your liking.
Transfer the steak to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chili flakes, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pickled red onion and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly caramelized.
Stuff each rocoto pepper with the onion mixture, followed by a few pieces of queso fresco.
Place the stuffed rocotos on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the peppers are tender.
Serve the sirloin steak tips with the rocoto relleno and enjoy!
